# Suggested resource or correction

## Resource

Link, title, author, and publication/update year when verified:

## Why it belongs here

What does it teach about C or C++ performance, or what gap does it fill?
For a correction, explain the failure and how you verified the replacement.

## Checks

- [ ] I read the destination and checked the title and relevance.
- [ ] I checked the collection and open suggestions for duplicates.
- [ ] The link points to the original source or a labeled, checked archive.
- [ ] The description is short, factual, and ends with a period.
- [ ] Dates and performance claims match the source and its test environment.
- [ ] I edited README.md; index.md includes it automatically.
- [ ] No affiliate links or tracking parameters were added.
